item.title: What if Revelation's trumpets are REAL?
item.description:
Join us to investigate if Revelation's trumpets herald literal global catastrophes.

An ancient scroll describes a third of the sea turning to blood. Was this just a vision, or a chilling prediction of literal events that science might one day explain?

The ancient texts of Revelation describe apocalyptic events like the sea turning to blood and stars falling. But what if these weren't mere metaphors? We investigate the original Greek to uncover if John's visions truly detail spiritual allegories or chilling predictions of physical, literal catastrophes that could unfold in our world.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 Apocalypse: Literal catastrophe, not metaphor
02:41 John's trumpets: Mental allegories
05:39 Prophetic language: Celestial collision
08:50 Smoke cloud from dark fissure
11:47 Gold censer, green patina, swinging

If you enjoy exploring the lesser-known side of the Bible, subscribe and hit the bell. New episodes every Tuesday and Sunday.

item.description:
A relaxing sleep story designed to help you unwind and fall asleep.
